title: Dinner in San Jose with a female crash retrieval program worker

tellings.quote: Oh, yeah. It was a woman. I met her. I we he my source, his wife, uh took me to her home, picked her up. We went into San Jose to have dinner at a German restaurant.

plain: A woman who worked on a secret program to recover crashed craft once had dinner with him at a German restaurant in San Jose, California, says Eric W. Davis, a scientist who has worked with the Pentagon. Davis says his source's wife drove him to the woman's home, they picked her up and the three went into town to eat, sometime between 1977 and 1989. He tells it as a meeting he was at himself, offered as a sign that such programs had real people working in them.
